sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values
sources.licence: project contribution under the repository's terms

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the lilies work (2026-10-18): every character from the floras in the lilies notes (plantgen-claude project-files/lilies/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Lilium philadelphicum, plant_name_id 279881.

growth_form.note: A bulbous herb with one leafy flowering stem a year, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown five years from seed, as a lily bulb takes three to five to flower; drawn at its third and fifth years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

generator.params.note: Its few flowers stand together at the stem's tip, FNA's 'inflorescences umbellate', drawn as a raceme a thirtieth of the stem long, as the herb program has no umbel of single flowers.

allometry.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.3-0.9 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 1.2 m'. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 0.6 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: stems usually 0.3-0.9 m; FNA gives only 'stems to 1.2 m'.

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stems to 1.2 m, glaucous

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves scattered, or mostly scattered with at least 1 distal whorl, or in 1-5 whorls or partial whorls

traits.leaf_whorls.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): in 1-5 whorls. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaves_per_whorl.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): 3-11 leaves per whorl. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 2.9-10.2 x 0.3-2.3 cm

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): leaves 0.3-2.3 cm wide, 3.5-18 times longer than wide. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): blade narrowly elliptic, sometimes linear, elliptic or oblanceolate

traits.leaf_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): more or less horizontal and drooping at tips, or ascending in sun

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): inflorescences umbellate, 1-3(-6)-flowered. The typical value is our pick of a usual plant inside that range.

traits.flower_posture.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowers erect, not fragrant

traits.corolla_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): perianth widely campanulate

traits.perianth_reflexion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals and petals somewhat recurved 1/4-2/5 along length from base

traits.perianth_reflexion_from.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): recurved 1/4-2/5 along length from base

traits.petal_shape.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals and petals distinctly clawed

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): red-orange or red-magenta, sometimes pale orange, pure red, or rarely yellow The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_base_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): nectar guides above claws yellow to orange The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.perianth_base_length.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals and petals distinctly clawed, nectar guides above claws yellow to orange; the claws' length is not given, the guides drawn to three tenths of the tepal, our reading

traits.perianth_spots.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): nectar guides above claws yellow to orange and spotted maroon, more pronounced on sepals

traits.perianth_spot_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): spotted maroon The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.tepal_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): sepals 4.9-8.2 cm, petals 4.5-7.7 cm

traits.stamen_exsertion.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): stamens strongly exserted

traits.anther_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): anthers dull maroon The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.pedicel_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): pedicel 2.5-10.5 cm

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 2.2-7.7 x 1-1.8 cm

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): capsules 1-1.8 cm wide

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 26 (2002), Lilium philadelphicum (efloras.org, read 2026-10-18): flowering late spring-summer (late May-Aug)
